changelog:
- YouTube Shorts Restored: Re-enabled native Shorts shelves, swipe reels, and bottom navigation pivot tab with cold-boot unprompted auto-open guard.
- YouTube Minimize/Resume Sync: Resolved playback desync where video played behind stuck buffering spinners or pause overlays when returning to the app.
- Tab Switcher Redesign: Moved Close All, + Ghost, and New Tab buttons to a pinned top header for permanent visibility with 7+ or 12+ tabs, styled in sleek AMOLED obsidian pure dark theme.
- Anti-Adblock & Twitter/X Embed Fix: Defused publisher anti-adblock detection traps and fixed embedded Twitter/X videos (syndication.twitter.com).
